summary: Iteration 6: Tested all 4 enhancements (Remediation SLAs, Assignee Directory, Policy Simulation, Digest Preferences) + Daily Digest Cron + regressions. Backend pytest: 14/14 passed. Frontend Playwright: all UI flows verified end-to-end (Settings digest save cycle, Kernel policy simulation live preview with hi/lo threshold, Remediation modal SLA 'Due in 7d' badge, assignee dropdown populated from /api/members, assign+resolve flow with success toast). Operational user can reach /app/settings. 403 for operational on /policies/simulate confirmed via backend test.
critical_code_review_comments: kernel/routes.py POST /policies/simulate: falls back to controls-only simulation which ignores non-threshold policy keys (correctly returns applies=false). Good.
scheduled.py _run_drift_digest correctly filters recipients by digest_cadence with 'weekly' default; 'off' excluded — matches spec.
workflow.start_remediation computes due_at = now+7d in UTC ISO; RemediationModal computes days via Date parsing — will correctly show 'Due in 7d' initially and 'Overdue Nd' once past due.
GET /api/members exposes emails to any authenticated org user (no PII beyond name/email/role). Acceptable for assignee dropdown.
Minor: PolicyModal shows the simulation card only when sim.applies is truthy — non-threshold policies correctly get no preview. Debounce of 400ms is reasonable.
